evidence.claim: The tungsten node matters because the key bottleneck is not only mining but the APT intermediate stage; external context states Chinese APT exports were zero in January and February 2026 and that NDAA Section 854 makes a DoD procurement ban on Chinese-origin tungsten binding on January 1, 2027.

CNBC reported on June 3, 2026 that tungsten supply pressure is tied to defense, aerospace, industrial tooling, electronics and manufacturing demand, with China as the dominant supplier and Almonty among potential non-Chinese supply sources.

memory_update.text: ALM is the clearest US-listed direct tungsten supply reference for the non-Chinese APT/defense-qualified tungsten node, but survival requires proof of Sangdong ramp, conversion route, offtakes, and defense qualification.

KMT is a likely underfollowed second-order candidate: an industrial tooling label may hide tungsten carbide, metallurgical powder, aerospace/defense and armor exposure, but raw-material cost and sourcing risk must be tested.

GMTL is a speculative shadow candidate for domestic tungsten mine supply because of Nevada assets and a DPA-funded Pilot Mountain PFS, but it is exploration-stage and not yet a processor or qualified supplier.

UAMY adds a hidden tungsten option through Fostung claims inside an antimony processor story; current link to APT/powder/defense-qualified tungsten remains weak and must be verified before later-layer inclusion.

Need a dedicated search for private/non-US processors such as Global Tungsten & Powders, Metal Tech, Plansee and specialty gas suppliers to map which US-listed companies have supplier/customer dependency on the true APT-to-powder bottleneck.

The node should be split in later layers into upstream mine/concentrate, APT/tungsten oxide conversion, tungsten powder/carbide, defense-qualified penetrator/armor/tooling, and semiconductor WF6 precursor chains.

node: Tungsten APT processing and non-Chinese defense-qualified tungsten supply
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the tungsten APT / non-Chinese defense-qualified supply node. The strongest direct public-market mappings are not mega-cap miners but niche tungsten mine developers and downstream carbide/powder users. ALM is the clearest direct non-China tungsten supply reference. KMT is the most investable downstream processor/tooling node with tungsten carbide, powders, aerospace and defense exposure. GMTL and UAMY are speculative shadow candidates: both add US/North American tungsten optionality but require major verification on resource quality, permitting, financing, processing route, offtakes, and qualification.
